name: RESEARCH_INSIGHT_SYMBOL_EVIDENCE_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: RESEARCH_INSIGHT_SYMBOL_EVIDENCE_20261108 — LQ-20261107-1081. research-insight-extractor was writing
COLA and RMD from bare headline acronyms, and a topic-slug news row still produced an insight. A symbol is
accepted only from a cashtag, a company name, or a held/watch source symbol. A topic-slug source row is
skipped and not inserted. Hermetic: fake cursor, synthetic rows, no database and no holdings file.
LQ-20261107-1141: a one-word issuer name that is a common word (Target, Visa, Apple, Gap) needs its
legal form, or a second signal (source/held/watch) plus a mid-sentence capital: 'price target' is not TGT.
